Open-Door Mentorship

Get personalized animation training, work on your demo reel strategy, learn a new animation tool, or get assistance with your next shot - the goal is yours to set.

Whether you’re a…

  • Beginning Animator

    New to industry animation training or want to revisit the fundamentals and the 12 Principles of Animation.

  • Student Animator

    Has had previous or current instruction, but still need support in getting to the next level.

  • Junior Artist

    Knows how to animate, but would like structure and guidance with your ideas and workflow.

Why join?

Personal

1-on-1 meetings tailored to your animation learning needs.  Get live feedback on your work or let’s have a chat about your journey’s next steps!

Flexible

Choose the session time from the Mentorship Calendar that works for you! Book a session every week, once a month- whenever you think you need support.

Perks

Get exclusive access to discounts on classes, tools & resources, and rigs. Keep lifetime access to the Mentorship Discord server.

How it works

  1. Schedule a session

    Pick an available session time
    on the Mentorship Calendar
    when the schedule is published
    on the 1st of every month.

  2. Submit your shot

    An hour before your session,
    send in your shot you want reviewed
    as a SyncSketch link.

  3. Live session

    Attend your session time to receive
    live feedback on your work.

  4. Receive recording

    Receive your session’s recording
    for your own use.

Signing up

$ 150 / Session

What you’ll receive in Open-Door Mentorship:

  • Live feedback
  • A recording of your session
  • Eligibility for a discount upon signing up for a Class
  • Access to the Mentorship Discord Server
Sign up for Open-Door Mentorship

Need more structure?

Join the Mentorship One-Shots program!

Over 10 weeks, you’ll tackle a step in the character animation process with mentorship guidance and feedback. By the end of the program, you’ll have a completed shot fit for your demo reel or personal project!
